map.按使用场景生成专业急救物品清单，支持勾选确认和导出打印。有备无患，关键时刻能救命: Generate a professional first-aid item list by usage scenario, supporting check-off confirmation and export/print. Better prepared than sorry; it can save lives at critical moments.
map.提示：定期检查急救包内药品有效期，每3-6个月更换过期物品。将急救包放在全家都知: Tip: regularly check the expiry of medicines in the first-aid kit, and replace expired items every 3-6 months. Place the kit where the whole family knows and can easily reach.
map.放在全家都知道且儿童不易拿到的地方: Place where the whole family knows but children cannot easily reach
map.避免高温潮湿环境（如浴室），药品需干燥阴凉存放: Avoid hot and humid environments (e.g. bathroom); medicines need dry and cool storage
map.车载急救包放在后备箱固定位置，避免行驶中散落: Car first-aid kit in a fixed position in the trunk, avoiding scattering while driving
map.户外急救包随身携带或放在背包外侧易取位置: Outdoor first-aid kit carried with you or placed in an easily accessible outer pocket of the backpack
map.每6个月更换即将过期的药品和耗材: Replace soon-to-expire medicines and consumables every 6 months
map.使用后及时补充消耗的物品: Replenish consumed items promptly after use
map.定期学习急救知识，确保家人都会使用: Regularly learn first-aid knowledge to ensure family members can use it

map.计划徒步、露营等户外活动前，生成针对性更强的户外急救包配置。: Before planning hiking, camping and other outdoor activities, generate a more targeted outdoor first-aid kit configuration.
map.单位或家庭定期盘点，对照清单勾选确认、导出打印后补充缺失物品。: Units or families take periodic inventory, check off against the list, export/print, then replenish missing items.
map.以「家庭急救包」基础配置为例: Example: basic configuration of a 'home first-aid kit'
map.建议常备：创可贴、无菌纱布与医用胶带、碘伏棉签或酒精片、剪刀、镊子、体温计、一次: Recommended basics: adhesive bandages, sterile gauze and medical tape, povidone-iodine swabs or alcohol pads, scissors, tweezers, thermometer, disposable gloves, emergency medicines (antipyretic, anti-diarrhea, anti-allergy, etc.), flashlight and spare batteries, first-aid manual. Car and outdoor scenarios need additional: reflective vest, safety hammer, emergency blanket, water-purification tablets, snake/insect-bite treatment supplies; office scenarios focus on trauma and fainting. The list supports check-off confirmation and export/print, but items are only the basics.
map.急救包里的药品多久检查一次？: How often should medicines in the kit be checked?
map.建议每 3–6 个月核对一次有效期，过期立即更换；液体与膏剂注意防冻、防高温；易: It is recommended to verify expiry every 3-6 months and replace expired ones immediately; liquids and ointments should be protected from freezing and high heat; fragile items (e.g. thermometer) stored separately and fixed to avoid breakage in transport.
map.有清单就能处理急症了吗？: Does a list mean you can handle emergencies?
map.不能。物品只是基础保障，真正救命依赖正确施救。建议参加红十字会等机构的急救培训，: No. Items are only basic support; truly saving lives depends on correct first aid. It is recommended to attend first-aid training from institutions such as the Red Cross, master skills like bleeding control, bandaging, CPR (cardiopulmonary resuscitation) and the Heimlich maneuver, and memorize the 120 emergency number.
